about: No-data / at-random model research, 2026-10-08. benchmarks.name: PROST physical reasoning (zero-shot, 10-concept macro average)
benchmarks.description: PROST (Aroca-Ouellette et al., Findings of ACL-IJCNLP 2021): 18,736 four-option multiple-choice questions from 14 templates over 10 physical concepts (direction, mass, height, circumference, stackable, rollable, graspable, breakable, slideable, bounceable), asked zero-shot. Score is the macro average of the 10 concept accuracies (multi-template concepts averaged first). Chance 0.25 as stated in the paper ('random guessing would yield an accuracy of 25%'). T5/UnifiedQA rows skip the sliding concept (asterisked 9-concept average) and are not comparable; UnifiedQA is also fine-tuned.

ledger.name: PROST (Aroca-Ouellette et al., Findings of ACL-IJCNLP 2021) - authors' own zero-shot runs
ledger.quote: ACL Anthology landing page footer for 2021.findings-acl.404: 'Materials published in or after 2016 are licensed on a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.' Findings of ACL-IJCNLP 2021 is an ACL publication. Section 4: 'We use Huggingface's (Wolf et al., 2020) pretrained models, see Table 4 for the full set.'
ledger.attribution:
Stephane Aroca-Ouellette, Cory Paik, Alessandro Roncone and Katharina Kann; (c)2021 Association for Computational Linguistics. PROST: Physical Reasoning about Objects through Space and Time. Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL-IJCNLP 2021, pages 4597-4608.
Source: https://aclanthology.org/2021.findings-acl.404.pdf
Licence: CC BY 4.0 - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Changes: selected numerical cells (Table 5 macro averages) transcribed into JSON; percentages divided by 100; model identities clarified. No questions or figures redistributed. No endorsement.
ledger.scope: Table 5 'Macro Average' column for GPT (openai-gpt) and GPT-2 B/M/L/XL, the five catalogue models. BERT/RoBERTa/ALBERT rows (not in catalogue), T5 and UnifiedQA rows (9-concept average without sliding; UnifiedQA fine-tuned), per-concept columns, Tables 6-7 not imported.

ledger.name: Cohere vendor-reported benchmark scores for its own models (cohere.com blog)
ledger.attribution: Cohere, vendor-reported results for Cohere's own models from the 'Introducing Command A+' blog post (May 20, 2026); individual figures from the post's text hand-recorded 2026-10-08; percentages converted to fractions. Lab-reported, not independent measurements. No endorsement.
ledger.quote: Owner rule (b), approved 2026-10-07 (UPDATING.md 'Vendor-reported scores'): a vendor's own published score for its own model, from its announcement, system/model card or docs, may be recorded by hand one figure at a time with the exact URL, date and printed settings; other labs' cells and cells credited to a third party excluded. The post's Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (37) is credited to Artificial Analysis and is not recorded; MMMU / MMMU Pro / MathVista figures are not recorded because the post gives no split (val/test, testmini, standard/vision).
ledger.scope: Command A+ only: τ²-Bench Telecom 85%, Terminal-Bench Hard 25%, CharXiv reasoning 52.7% from the body text. Chart-only figures (AIME 2025, IFBench, SciCode, MT-AIME, WMT24++) and internal North evaluations not recorded. Command A Reasoning (37%, 3%) and Command A Vision (46.9%) are printed but are not catalogue models.

gaps.why: xAI publishes no benchmark score for this model: x.ai/news/grok-build-0-1 (May 29 2026), x.ai/news/grok-build-cli (May 25), x.ai/news/grok-build-open-source (Jul 15) and docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-build-0.1 have none (the widely cited 70.8% SWE-bench Verified has no xAI primary page). Terminal-Bench submissions (Apache-2.0, harbor-framework/terminal-bench @3e9bf0e) have only Grok 4.5/4.6 run inside the Grok Build harness, not grok-build-0.1; Aider polyglot (last update 2025-10) predates it. Open LLM Leaderboard-style data not applicable.

Partial: three vendor-reported figures recorded from Cohere's launch post (tau2-telecom 0.85, terminalbench-hard-gemma4 0.25, charxiv-rq 0.527) under a new first-party-cohere-scores entry, but the post's comparators are Command A Reasoning (08-2025) and Command A Vision (07-2025), which are not in the catalogue, so each run has one catalogue model and nothing counts yet. Adding those two open-weights Cohere models (comparison-only) with the printed 37%/3%/46.9% would make the runs count. Independent sources checked without a Command A+ row: Terminal-Bench submissions, Aider polyglot (last update 2025-10), earlier thin-llm list (LMArena, Epoch, BFCL, EuroEval etc.); the HF card has no table.
